project.name: jawelte (wiremock-module aggregator)
project.description: WireMock CDI integration for jawelte. wiremock-module/api ships the @EnableWireMock test-class annotation and the @WireMockEndpoint meta-qualifier (annotations only, no upstream library types). wiremock-module/impl ships the WireMockLifecycleAdapter (TestModuleLifecyclePort at @Priority(75)), a CDI producer that bridges the api to the upstream WireMockServer / WireMock library types, a CDI extension for @WireMockEndpoint discovery and synthetic-bean registration, and a BeanScopeMapper SPI provider (SL-registered on core/api's SPI) that remaps the per-endpoint registry's impl-internal marker annotation to @TestClassScoped. The BeanScopeMapper provider is registered unconditionally (no testcontrol-module classpath probe), but it resolves its target scope (@TestClassScoped) reflectively via an MP Config FQCN with Class.forName, so wiremock-module/impl has no compile-time dependency on scope-module; when scope-module is absent the target resolves to null and the remap is a no-op.
